## GE Vernova Framed as Direct Beneficiary of Data Center Power Demand and Grid Upgrade Cycle

GEV is solidifying as a consensus expression of the power-as-AI-bottleneck trade; sustained multi-outlet coverage suggests the market is treating grid and power infrastructure as a durable AI capex theme with a long tail, not a single-quarter read.

- Both outlets position GEV as a primary beneficiary of surging AI data center power demand and broader grid infrastructure upgrades.
- Coverage spans two angles: opportunity framing ('game changer') and opinion on the structural AI power-demand dynamic.
- The macro signal is power supply as an active constraint on AI infrastructure build-out, not a distant risk.
- High classifier confidence reflects cross-outlet consensus on the GEV/power thesis.
